verdict.rationale: Aircall's API reference documents URL-path versioning (v1/v2 endpoints, v2-suffixed webhook events) with a stated backward-compatibility intent. It also has an Announcements table with a Deprecation/Last Change Date column and a dated changelog of removed endpoints. However, it states no formal deprecation policy, such as a committed notice window or sunset timeline. Missing for 10: committed deprecation notice window/sunset policy, independent corroboration of how deprecations are handled in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Aircall APIs and Webhooks are versioned to allow for continuous evolution and improvement while maintaining backward compatibility for existing integrations. API versions are indicated in the URL path.
Please refer to this section for announcements related to deprecation or changes
